one_liner: An AI software engineer that can handle complex engineering tasks independently.
auth_notes: Uses a principal + token model or service keys depending on the API surface (e.g., Desktop API vs v1 API).
gate_notes: Every API endpoint except GET /v3/self is gated by a specific permission.
verdict_reason: Devin provides documented API endpoints and authentication models, but access is gated by specific permissions and requires enterprise/approval onboarding.

evidence.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
The Devin API uses a principal + token model. A principal is who you are (your identity), and a token is how you prove it (your credential).
